label: coach_gym_koori_first_00
text: Brrrrrr... I’m freezing.[VAR 0x0114(001A)]

label: coach_gym_koori_first_01
text: The AC’s way too strong in here...[VAR 0x0114(001A)]

label: coach_gym_koori_sp01_00
text: So, you’re the one who called me, huh?[VAR 0x0114(001A)]

label: coach_gym_koori_sp01_01
text: You DO know this is gonna be a major downer\nfor the school, right?[VAR 0x0114(001A)]

label: coach_gym_koori_sp01_select_02

label: coach_gym_koori_sp01_03
text: ...You’re awfully sure about this. Where does that\nconfidence come from?[VAR 0x0114(001A)]

label: coach_gym_koori_sp01_03b
text: Hmph, I figured... You’re not sure about this\neither, are you?[VAR 0x0114(001A)]

label: coach_gym_koori_sp01_04
text: Well, I’m here anyway. I’m going to do my job.[VAR 0x0114(001A)]

label: coach_gym_koori_sp01_05
text: I am a professional, believe it or not...[VAR 0x0114(001A)]

label: coach_gym_koori_sp02_00
text: You, huh...[VAR 0x0114(001A)]

label: coach_gym_koori_sp02_01
text: Have you been to the Polar Biome in the\nTerarium? That place is pretty impressive.[VAR 0x0114(001A)]

label: coach_gym_koori_sp02_02
text: The snow’s so soft and powdery... I can’t believe\nit’s artificial.[VAR 0x0114(001A)]

label: coach_gym_koori_sp02_03
text: Plenty of straight slopes, and lots of curves too.\nIt’s perfect for snowboarding.[VAR 0x0114(001A)]

label: coach_gym_koori_sp02_select_01
text: You’re gonna board?!

label: coach_gym_koori_sp02_select_02
text: Let’s hit the slopes!

label: coach_gym_koori_sp02_04
text: Oh, no, I didn’t mean it like that...[VAR 0x0114(001A)]

label: coach_gym_koori_sp02_05
text: I can’t help but check out the slopes when I see\nsnowy mountains. Old habits die hard.[VAR 0x0114(001A)]

label: coach_gym_koori_sp02_06
text: This academy’s something else though, eh?\nBuilding a mountain like that on school grounds...[VAR 0x0114(001A)]

label: coach_gym_koori_sp03_00
text: I just came back from climbing that big mountain\nin the Polar Biome.[VAR 0x0114(001A)]

label: coach_gym_koori_sp03_01
text: Cetoddle and the rest were all hyped to be on a\nmountain other than Glaseado.[VAR 0x0114(001A)]

label: coach_gym_koori_sp03_02
text: I guess it rubbed off on me. I just couldn’t resist\nand, well...I had a few runs on my board.[VAR 0x0114(001A)]

label: coach_gym_koori_sp03_select_03
text: Niiice!

label: coach_gym_koori_sp03_select_04
text: How’d it go?

label: coach_gym_koori_sp03_03
text: Oh, the snow was good. Yeah... Real good.[VAR 0x0114(001A)]

label: coach_gym_koori_sp03_04
text: I hadn’t boarded in a long time, so I think I got\na bit too fired up.[VAR 0x0114(001A)]

label: coach_gym_koori_sp03_05
text: You know, I’d made up my mind that I wouldn’t\nsnowboard anymore...[VAR 0x0114(001A)]

label: coach_gym_koori_sp03_06
text: but maybe I can from time to time—just when\nI’m here.[VAR 0x0114(001A)]

label: coach_gym_koori_trade_01_00
text: ...Yeah, yeah, I’m weak-willed. Sorry.[VAR 0x0114(001A)]

label: coach_gym_koori_trade_01_01
text: But if I’m gonna be uncool, I might as well lean\ninto it. I’ve got another tiresome idea.[VAR 0x0114(001A)]

label: coach_gym_koori_trade_01_02
